units.source_text: 据吴六段解说，如果白下了“5·一”、“6·一”的一扳一粘，

en.t: According to the explanation by Wu 6-dan, if White played the hane-and-connect at "5-1" and "6-1",

units.source_text: “黑即使下121，白可以不下122，而下‘8·一’位活净，

en.t: "even if Black then played 121, White could ignore 122 and live cleanly by playing at the "8-1" point,
so Black would be short one ko threat."

units.source_text: 他只是简单地触及黑下121的意义。

en.t: He only touched briefly on the significance of Black playing 121.

units.source_text: 大竹七段下这一手，肯定也是考虑到这层意义。

en.t: When Otake 7-dan played this move, he must also have had this meaning in mind.
